prompt: When choosing among alternatives, first separate mandatory constraints from comparative preferences, and preserve only priorities the user actually stated. Keep plausible alternatives as qualifying, disqualified by observed evidence, or unresolved; do not treat missing or conflicting evidence as favorable. Do not commit merely because one acceptable option appears: use a defensible stopping reason, compare every still-plausible alternative under the same criteria, and immediately before any consequential action recheck the exact choice and resulting state against the original request.
